QuestInfo.name: Seaworthy
QuestInfo.parent: Information about the Slumbering Dragon Island
QuestInfo.0: #p1002101#, who has been looking at the map for awhile, has a grim face... What could it be? Talk to #b#p1002101##k.
QuestInfo.1:
#p1002101# says the ship must be strengthened to survive a trip through the reefs. He needs some #b#t4000196##k and #b#t4000197##k. Using those two materials will make the ship invincible, like the Titanic!

#i4000196# #t4000196# #b#c4000196# / 20#k
#i4000197# #t4000197# #b#c4000197# / 20#k
QuestInfo.2: You gave #p1002101# #t4000196# and #t4000197#. #p1002101# says it will take some time to strengthen the ship, so he'll contact you when he is done.

0.0: Hm, this is going to be a tough one. Not only is it windy out there, there are reefs everywhere. They'll tear the ship apart like anchovies eating whales! Err, you know what I mean.
0.1: #i4000196##t4000196# and #i4000197##t4000197# are what we need to strengthen the ship. You can find them in the #bExcavation Site#k in #m102000000#.
0.2: #t4000196# and #t4000197# will make our ship as strong as a rock... But it will still float, I promise. The monsters in the #bExcavation Site#k of #m102000000# are pretty awful. Do you think you can handle them?

yes.0: Are you feeling confident? Get me #b20 #t4000196#s#k and #b20 #t4000197#s#k from the #b#o2230111##k monsters in the #bExcavation Site#k.

no.0: I guess you're all talk. I'm not risking my ship for a faker.

1.0: Are we all set on #t4000196# and #t4000197#? Whoa, look at that! We could probably go anywhere with skills like yours.

yes.0: Great. I'll get to work reinforcing the ship. It's going to take some time, so go busy yourself and I'll contact you when it's ready.

item.0: Hm... You don't have #b20 #t4000196# and 20 #t4000197##k items yet? Understandable, since they're pretty rare. I hear you can get some from monsters at the #bExcavation Site#k...
